# CKEditor

Skills that teach agents to work with CKEditor. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [ckeditor/skills](https://github.com/ckeditor/skills), at commit `261766a`.

Install, configure, and integrate CKEditor 5 in JavaScript projects.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **CKEditor**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **CKEditor**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install ckeditor@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

- `ckeditor`: install and configure CKEditor 5.
- `ckeditor-bundle`: build a custom bundle.
- `ckeditor-update`: update CKEditor 5 in a project.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

CKEditor 5 itself is licensed separately from these skills. The skills mention the open-source (GPL) option and a `licenseKey` setting for commercial use. The MIT licence of this plugin covers only the skill text.

The plugin ships no scripts.
